exposure: Use of the Versius surgical system for robot-assisted total laparoscopic hysterectomy
outcome: Rate of unplanned conversion to conventional laparoscopic or open surgery
cohort: The participants were 144 adult women requiring total hysterectomy.
finding: The Versius surgical system was found to be a safe and effective option for total laparoscopic hysterectomy, with a 1.4% unplanned conversion rate and 4.9% adverse event rate.
